race.comment: WINNING HARLOW (12) comes back a few levels today and ready to get the job done at her third race start. Gripped on late when fourth over 1200m at Eagle Farm. Blinkers go on and should relish this trip. No excuses. LATIN LIGHTS (6) resumed for the new yard with a plugging sixth over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Assess on her narrow second at Geelong over 1525m last January. Expected to go close. LA REGINA (9) gets the right set-up for this and looks to have each way prospects after she worked hard early for a tough on pace sixth over 1400m at Coffs Harbour. Gets good weight relief for this and is worth serious consideration. DIVINE MANDATE (1) heavily supported on debut ($1.85 fav), when a fast finishing second over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Looking for this trip and expected to go close.
